name: Lashing
description: A lashing: turns of cord binding two spars where they cross.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 40%, 100% 40%, 100% 60%, 0 60%); clip-path: polygon(0 40%, 100% 40%, 100% 60%, 0 60%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 26%; width: 48%; height: 48%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 34%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 34%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { :before { -webkit-clip-path: polygon(40% 0, 60% 0, 60% 100%, 40% 100%); clip-path: polygon(40% 0, 60% 0, 60% 100%, 40% 100%); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
